title: VanArsdel Controls VC-1500: Web Server Authentication Bypass (sample vendor PSIRT)
summary: Sample (fictional). The integrated web server of VanArsdel Controls VC-1500 CPUs before V3.1.4 allows an unauthenticated attacker on the network to read and modify device configuration via crafted requests to the management interface.
recommended_mitigations: Update to firmware V3.1.4 or later. Restrict access to the web server to trusted networks; disable the web server if unused.

title: AdatumOS: Remote Access Gateway Remote Code Execution (sample vendor PSIRT)
summary: Sample (fictional). A command injection vulnerability in the remote access gateway of AdatumOS allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
recommended_mitigations: Upgrade AdatumOS to a fixed release. Enable threat prevention signatures; restrict remote access portal exposure.
